Title: The Earth: Its Origin, History and Physical Constitution (2nd ed.)

Authors: Gurtin, M. E.; Pipkin, A. C.
Title: A general theory of heat conduction with finite wave speeds
Journal_or_publisher: Archive for Rational Mechanics and Analysis
relevance_one_line: Hereditary (memory-kernel) heat conduction with finite propagation speed - the parent of every memory/delay flux law, including the integral form used here. Key is present in refs.bib but is never cited in any section file.

Title: Second-sound phenomena in inviscid, thermally relaxing gases
Journal_or_publisher: Discrete and Continuous Dynamical Systems - B
relevance_one_line: Where the Moore-Gibson-Thompson (MGT) equation is derived from the Maxwell-Cattaneo law and its second-sound branch is analysed - the acoustic-side origin of the MGT model the paper uses.

Authors: Conti, M.; Pata, V.; Quintanilla, R.
